text:
maria: quick thread — thinking about a minimal-risk cutover for moving the control plane out of shared VPCs into per-region peered controlplanes (goal: reduce blast radius + simplify audits). canaries + PrivateLink first?

josh: +1 to smaller blast radius. two immediate worries: route table churn during cutover and preserving egress IPs we currently rely on.

devon: can we stage with read-only PrivateLink endpoints to mirror state and validate traffic patterns before full peering? much lower risk than tearing down peering.

anika: agreed on PrivateLink canary. need explicit fallback semantics: if PrivateLink becomes unhealthy, do we route back to shared cp automatically or fail closed? who owns the policy?

maria: owners idea: eng-platform for routing policy, eng-infra for NAT/egress rotation, security for policy review. proposed rollout sequence: 
1) provision per-region CP VPCs (cp-region-*) and expose PrivateLink endpoints for read-only APIs
2) sync certs + tokens via ops job with short TTL for safe rotation
3) route 5% traffic to new path, monitor metrics (latency, auth failures, 5xx)
4) incrementally increase, then migrate write paths and deprecate old peering

sam: DNS is the sticky bit. we can't break tenant-facing names. propose using split-horizon + healthchecked weighted records so failback is instant.

lee: ops note: SNAT collisions will be messy if we don't pre-allocate. plan to reserve ephemeral egress IPs for cp-region and map them in advance so customers' allowlists don't get broken mid-cutover.

devon: cert rotation details: use SSM param store / tags to coordinate. simple pseudocode for upload + rollout:

```
aws ssm put-parameter --name /cp/cert/${REGION} --value "$(cat cert.pem)" --type SecureString --overwrite
# rollout job reads param, hot-swaps cert in place
```

anika: metric checklist for canary: cp_auth_fail_rate, nat_mapping_errors, route_propagation_lag, dns_failovers, cp_write_latency. set alert thresholds before starting.

oncall-bot: Incident policy updated: controlplane-peering-change -> page when cp_auth_fail_rate > 0.5% over 2m.

josh: don't forget cross-account IAM: peered VPCs still need role trusts for KMS/decryption calls. validate those in the spike.

maria: actionable next steps: I'll draft an RFC with exact sequence, terraform plan, and rollback procedures. volunteers for a spike to validate PrivateLink + DNS failover? @devon @josh?

devon: I'm in — will build a spike to mirror read-only APIs over PrivateLink and capture perf baseline.

josh: I can own routing automation + terraform modules for peering and route table updates.

sam: I'll write the DNS healthcheck/playbook and ops runbook for rollback.

maria: perfect. capturing these as action items and I'll link the RFC here when it's ready :thumbsup:
